extraction_notes.site: Pontificia Università della Santa Croce ID
extraction_notes.notes: Koha-style API response wrapping a MARC21 authority record (IT-RoPUS 80295) for Twain, Mark, 1835-1910; RDA, Italian cataloguing language. ISNI given (0000000121324854) differs from the one Open Library gives.
Microdata WebPage value is the full German author-page text (short biography, 'Werke u.a.' list, and 29 titles available in Projekt Gutenberg); the other two items are header/navigation chrome.

VIAF's MARC21 copy (as JSON) of the RILM authority record NYNYRILM|1598, headed 'Clemens, Samuel Langhorne (Mark Twain)' with EDTF dates, death place, nationality and occupation. 9xx fields are VIAF enrichments: 998 = VIAF cluster member records (listed in same_as as SOURCE|id, not URIs; excluded LC n 82045653 'Twain, Mark (Spirit)', and mis-clustered NKC jx20050822002 Olivia Langdon Clemens / PLWABN Karłowicz), 996 = records VIAF kept in other clusters (not used), 910/912 = title strings VIAF d

embedded_opengraph.json is the Douban personage page metadata with a long Chinese biography; xhr_2.json lists his books on Douban (10 of 196 items). Odd: og:url points to personage/27242749, not the author id 4507366.

extraction_notes.site: Australian National Maritime Museum person ID
extraction_notes.notes: Minimal page metadata: a schema.org Person with only a name, and OpenGraph title/URL.
OpenGraph only from the National Library of Israel authority page: og:title carries the heading with dates; og:image is a generic PersonalName placeholder.

xhr_3.json is the Provenio (Czech, Verbis/Kpwin-style) authority record API with MARC-like fields (a100, a400, a665, a678...) copied from the NKC national authority jn19981002263; xhr_6.json is the see/see-also hierarchy tree; xhr_4.json is an empty related-records search (0 results, about_entity false).
OpenGraph metadata only from the NNDB person page: title, URL and portrait image. No biographical text.

OpenGraph metadata for the Google Doodle page 'Mark Twain's 176th Birthday Doodle'. It describes the doodle artwork, not the person (no biographical facts); og:image is the doodle and has a malformed 'https:https://' prefix. Nothing extracted.

VIAF-style MARC21-in-JSON authority record for the Lebanese National Library heading توين، مارك، 1835-1910, with VIAF cluster fields (9xx). 998 links to other cluster members were turned into same_as URIs where a URI pattern is known (LC 'Twain, Mark (Spirit)' n82045653 excluded); others kept as identifiers. 996 entries are unmatched records and were skipped.

extraction_notes.site: Diamond Catalog ID for persons and organisations
extraction_notes.notes: OpenGraph metadata for the Diamond (ALKINDI4 OPAC) agent page; og:title is the authorized heading with dates, og:description just 'Person'.
OpenGraph metadata from MYmovies.it person page 106220; only the name, a country in parentheses and a generic site blurb. og:image is empty.

News tag page for 'mark twain'. The OpenGraph title and description are templated tag-page text with the site logo; the RSS feed (alternate_1.xml) has an empty channel with no items; xhr_2.json is an empty Parse.ly analytics response. about_entity false for all three files: no data about Twain beyond the lowercase tag slug.
OpenGraph metadata for the Klexikon (German children's encyclopedia) article; og:description is a truncated short German bio, og:image a Wikimedia Commons portrait.
OpenGraph metadata for the EGU term page; only the heading 'Twain, Mark' and URL, no description.

extraction_notes.site: Les Archives du spectacle person ID
extraction_notes.notes: schema.org Person microdata and OpenGraph tags of the person page. og:description is generic site boilerplate, not a description of the person.

extraction_notes.site: Library of the University of Santiago de Compostela authority ID
extraction_notes.notes: Primo (Ex Libris) PNX authority record from the USC catalogue: heading, see-from tracings and control ids. The first see-from form 'Langhorne Clemens, Samuel' is an inverted variant as given.

VIAF's copy (as JSON) of the National Library of Lithuania UNIMARC authority record LIH|LNB:V-1145;=_z_W, with Lithuanian/Russian variant names, Lithuanian notes, birth/death places (640) and cited sources (810). 9xx fields are VIAF enrichments: 998 = VIAF cluster member records (listed in same_as as SOURCE|id, not URIs; excluded LC n 82045653 'Twain, Mark (Spirit)', and mis-clustered NKC jx20050822002 Olivia Langdon Clemens / PLWABN Karłowicz), 996 = records VIAF kept in other clusters (not use
OpenGraph tags of the Tebeosfera author page. The record is headed under the real name; og:description is empty. The image file is named mark_twain.jpg.

OpenGraph metadata from the Cinemagia (Romanian film site) person page 55439; og:description holds a long Romanian biography. The biography contains factual slips (attributes 'Uncle Tom's Cabin' to him, says 1962 for 1862, 1889 for Hadleyburg); values were taken as stated.

OpenGraph of the Mark Twain author index page in the Age of Reason section; og:description describes the collection (five resources), not the person. xhr_1.json is only a category path ('/categories/aor-twain').

OpenGraph of the CiNii Research person page, xhr_5 = first 5 of 2006 related books where crid 1981993809649634716 (Twain, Mark) is creator, xhr_9 = openBD/ONIX record for one of those books with a Japanese author biography. Odd: the page resolves to crid 1981993809649634716, not the Wikidata ID 1140000791666601344.

conneg_4.json (RDF/JSON) and xhr_1.json (SPARQL s/p/o bindings) describe chname:マーク・トウェイン; xhr_5.json gives labels of linked resources (incl. NDL heading 'Twain, Mark, 1835-1910'); embedded_microdata.json is the Snorql page microdata. export_3/4/6/8 and browser_export_3/4/6/8 are 'illegal-param' error responses (describe of time/dbpedia URIs) with no entity data. Dates are year-only (time:1835 / time:1910).

OPAC SBN search-result JSON (single hit) rendering the authority record for 'Twain, Mark' as table rows (variants, dates, note, language, country, sources, ISNI, update date, SBN id). Note text misspells Connecticut as 'Connetticut'.

Tor.com now redirects to Reactor (reactormag.com). browser_alternate_1.xml is the author RSS feed 'Mark Twain, Author at Reactor' with one item (the reprint 'A Ghost Story', 2012) - about the entity. alternate_1.xml is the site-wide Reactor feed with no Twain mentions and xhr_2.json is Macmillan OneTrust cookie-consent config; both about_entity false, nothing extracted from them.

embedded_microdata.json is a breadcrumb list ending in 'Mark Twain'; embedded_opengraph.json has name, poster image and a Turkish one-line bio. xhr_1.json is an HTML fragment of two user comments (not site data), so nothing was extracted from it.

xhr_1.json is a Wayback Machine capture-calendar response (capture counts per month 2016-2021, HTTP status codes); about_entity false, it carries no data about Twain. The page appears to have been fetched via the Internet Archive.
OpenGraph metadata of the Africultures person page; og:description is a flattened text of the page listing role (Ecrivain/ne) and one book. og:image is a generic site image (not of Twain).
OpenGraph tags of the KBR OPAC authority page (SYRACUSE-AUT). The title holds the heading with life years and a trailing record-type code ' - p' (person).

extraction_notes.site: Piraeus Bank Group Cultural Foundation Library (A) ID
extraction_notes.notes: xhr_1.json is the openABEKT authority record (UNIMARC tag 200 personal name, 'Καθιερωμένη' = authorized) for 'Twain, Mark'; xhr_3.json is a DataTables list of the 8 linked bibliographic records (Greek editions, role 070 'Συγγραφέας' = author). Titles in xhr_3 are truncated by the site; only the title part before ' / ' is kept.

alternate_1.xml is the site-wide Atom feed of recent changes on wikikids.nl (Recente wijzigingen: Odoorn, Klijndijk, Diego Maradona, etc.), not the Mark Twain article. No mention of Twain or Clemens anywhere in it, so nothing was extracted.

OpenGraph metadata of the Universalis biography article; og:description is a truncated French excerpt explaining the pseudonym. Article author is Bernard Poli (author of the encyclopedia article, not related to Twain).
Open English WordNet synset 10920482-n (JSON and WN-LMF XML) with three lemmas and a gloss; license CC BY 4.0 from the lexicon header.
OpenGraph metadata from Portal da Literatura author page 757; og:description is a truncated Portuguese biography.
OpenGraph metadata for the Wellcome Collection concept page; og:title is the name, og:description is generic site boilerplate and og:image a site icon (neither extracted).
OpenGraph block of the Arab Encyclopedia article; og:description is the article lead in Arabic.
Breadcrumb microdata and OpenGraph tags of the MyAnimeList person page. og:description is generic site boilerplate and was not used as a description.

Store norske leksikon article: microdata holds the full page text (fact box, biography, works, bibliography) plus breadcrumb, article author and image; OpenGraph gives page title and image. Death place is spelled 'Conneticut' in the source.

extraction_notes.site: Los Angeles Review of Books author ID
extraction_notes.notes: browser_xhr_6.json is an A/B-testing/experiment config response (host, path, lift probabilities) for the page; about_entity false, no data about Twain.
OpenGraph metadata for the Poets.org poet page; og:description is a short bio. Address/phone/email fields are the Academy of American Poets' own contact details, not about Twain.
embedded_microdata.json is a bare schema.org Person with only a name; alternate_1.xml is the person's RSS productions feed, which has a channel header but no items (no productions listed).
xhr_1.json is an Italian Wikipedia summary (image, HTML extract, URL) that the Parsifal page embeds. xhr_4.json lists the work clusters linked to the author, with manifestations.
xhr_1.json is a SPARQL result (Wikidata lookup made by the NDL page) linking the record to Q7245 with its Japanese label and Japanese Wikipedia article. No NDL authority data itself is in the file.
OpenGraph metadata for the DigitaltMuseum person page 'Twain, Mark (1835 - 1910)'; title and description are identical.
schema.org Person microdata whose 'value' is the whole page text (person info block plus ad-network junk), and breadcrumbs. Works are TV/film adaptations credited as 'Based on the Novel Of'.

MARC21-slim authority record (JSON-ified) for BAnQ record B2Q|0000005713 'Twain, Mark, 1835-1910', in VIAF's enriched form: local 9xx fields list linked titles (910/912/919), co-authors (950/955), publishers, and 998 fields listing matched authority records in other VIAF sources. 998 match for LC n 82045653 'Twain, Mark (Spirit)' is a different entity and was skipped. same_as URIs other than ISNI are constructed from source|id pairs in 998 $2.
OpenGraph metadata from a Wayback Machine snapshot of the Golden wiki page; article:author (Roman Odarenko) is the page editor, not a related agent.

OpenGraph metadata for the author's 'all writings' page. The title and description are templated text with the name inserted; og:image is the generic site logo. 'Urdu, Hindi & English' are the collection's languages, not his.
Minimal OpenGraph block from the DAHR page: only og:title and site name.

Wikibase entity JSON for Kunstenpunt item Q142191 (ingested from data.kunsten.be as an 'Uitvoerder'/performer). Local property semantics inferred: P26 = data.kunsten.be URL (qualifier P27 -> Q58527), P31 = name as monolingual text, P75 = Wikidata QID, P1 -> Q58543 (unlabelled local class).
OpenGraph metadata for the Pixiv Encyclopedia article: Japanese name and a one-line description. og:image is a generated OGP card, not a portrait.

embedded_opengraph.json is page metadata for Comic Vine 4005-58664, which is a CHARACTER page (Mark Twain as a comics character) with a one-line description of the real person. xhr_4.json (405 KB) is a OneTrust cookie-consent config (about_entity false, nothing extracted).

OpenGraph only from the Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek person page for GND 1106405730, titled with the real name Samuel Langhorne Clemens (a GND record distinct from the main 'Twain, Mark' GND 118624822).

RSS 2.0 feed of the site's front-page feature slides (10 items on Nevada topics such as Reno, Burning Man, Bonanza). Only the item titled 'Mark Twain' is about the entity; the other items were ignored.
OpenGraph block from the PRH author page; og:description is a truncated bio. og:image is a book cover, not a portrait.

xhr_1.json is an ad-blocker/consent overlay config (page chrome, not about the entity - nothing extracted). xhr_7.json is the PDB profile 973 API record (Wikipedia-derived description, MBTI typing); xhr_12.json lists related works/fictional subcategories and other people's profiles (only works grouped under 'Mark Twain' kept).
OpenGraph metadata with only a templated og:description ('<name> cards, checklist, gallery, forum, and collection tracking'); the only datum is the name.

xhr_1.json is the NARA Catalog (Elasticsearch) authority record naId 10574508 for 'Clemens, Samuel Langhorne, 1835-1910' (LCCN n 93099439); xhr_5.json is a search of the 3 description records linked to that authority (a court case file, a patent file, a slide series). NARA keeps a separate authority for the pseudonym 'Twain, Mark, 1835-1910' (naId 10581697). Dates are year-only; logicalDate values (1835-01-01 / 1910-12-31) are range placeholders.
OpenGraph metadata for the Google Arts & Culture entity page; og:description is a one-line bio, og:title the name plus site suffix.
schema.org Person/Book/BookSeries microdata and OpenGraph from the Goodreads author page. Person.url points to marktwainproject.org (an external website, not an authority id).

Foto Atlas (Turkish historic photo site) WordPress subject-taxonomy term 'Mark Twain': microdata holds page text with a Turkish Wikipedia lead, the Wikidata QID and the English Wikidata description; alternate_4 is the WP REST term, alternate_3 the RSS feed of its one linked photo (III. Ahmet Sebili ve Çeşmesi, not of Twain). og:image is that photo, so not used.
schema.org Person microdata and OpenGraph from the Babelio author page (French); og:description is a truncated French biography.
OpenGraph metadata only (title and URL). Odd: the og:url uses a different id form (pessoas/28271-mark-twain) than the Wikidata value (pessoa407320/mark-twain).
OpenGraph metadata for the Ozon person page; og:title is the person's name in Russian, og:description is generic store boilerplate (not a bio, not extracted).

extraction_notes.site: PMB – Personen der Moderne Basis person ID
extraction_notes.notes: OpenGraph page metadata plus the APIS REST API JSON for person 26252 (dates, gender, professions, collections, sameAs links, created/updated). first_name is null; 'published' is false.

OpenGraph + breadcrumb microdata from the Genius artist page; og:description is generic Genius boilerplate. xhr_5.json is a leaderboard of Genius contributor users (not about the entity) and was ignored.

extraction_notes.site: National Historical Museums of Sweden ID
extraction_notes.notes: OpenGraph metadata for the SHM collections person page. The name is mis-parsed by the source (family name 'Langhorne, Mark Twain', given name 'Clemens Samuel'); kept as given. Description mentions a Wikidata link but gives no URI; 1 related object.
OpenGraph metadata of the Adelphi author catalogue page; og:description is empty, only the name and URL are present.

BookBub author page: browser_xhr_1 is the author profile API (name, biography, genre tags), browser_xhr_2 the author's book list, OpenGraph repeats the biography (truncated). browser_xhr_7 is a list of BookBub blog posts (not about the entity) and was ignored.
OpenGraph tags of the ANB article page. The title carries the heading, life years and occupations; og:description only repeats the title with a publisher line.
schema.org WebPage microdata and OpenGraph tags of a Larousse media (image) page for Mark Twain, not the encyclopedia article itself; the batch listed each file three times. 1310315 is the media id.
OpenGraph page metadata only; og:title is the person's name and og:description a one-line bio.
Not BookBrainz data itself: an XHR returning the English Wikipedia lead extract (pageid 154450, 'Mark Twain') that the BookBrainz author page embeds. All values below come from that HTML extract.
OpenGraph metadata for the poet page: name and portrait. og:description is the generic site tagline, not about Twain, so it was not used.

VIAF's MARC21 copy (as JSON) of the UAE University Libraries authority record UAE|Mill_a10002910, which is a copy of LC NAF n 79021164 (many script variants, 500 links to Clemens / Snodgrass / Conte, 663 note also naming Alden, Jean François, and 670 sources incl. Wikipedia with birth/death dates and places). 9xx fields are VIAF enrichments: 998 = VIAF cluster member records (listed in same_as as SOURCE|id, not URIs; excluded LC n 82045653 'Twain, Mark (Spirit)', and mis-clustered NKC jx20050822

MARC21 authority (MARCXML-as-JSON, VIAF cluster format) for the DBC record 87097968223113, whose 100 heading is the pseudonym 'Conte, Louis de'; it also carries VIAF 998 links to Twain headings from many sources. File was listed twice in the batch. Gender 375 is ISO 5218 code 1 (male). same_as URIs from 996 are VIAF-cluster source codes (SOURCE|id) expanded to standard URI patterns; codes without a deterministic URI pattern (BNF, NKC, BAV, J9U, BIBSYS, NUKAT, NSK, ARBABN, SKMASNL) were left out.

browser_alternate_1.json is the Wikibase Special:EntityData JSON for SNARC item Q69664 (labels/aliases/claims); embedded_opengraph.json gives label + English description. Item-valued claims are SNARC-local QIDs, so their English labels were resolved by grepping browser_alternate_2.ttl (the Turtle export of the same entity) for rdfs:label.
Generic Wolfram|Alpha OpenGraph (site description, site image); the only entity-specific content is the entity code in og:title. No name, dates or description of the person.
OpenGraph metadata from the NPG person page; og:description is just 'Writer'. URL slug reads 'mark-twain-samuel-langhorne-clemens'.
OpenGraph metadata of the Discogs artist page 463414 'Mark Twain (2)' (the '(2)' is Discogs' disambiguation suffix). Only a name, generic description, image and URL; nothing biographical.
OpenGraph metadata of the Harper's Magazine tag archive page; only the tag title 'Mark Twain Archives' relates to the entity, og:image is a generic site banner.

VIAF-style MARC21-in-JSON authority record of the Slovak National Library ('Twain, Mark, 1835-1910', 1130 datafields, mostly VIAF 9xx cluster/title/co-author data). Works capped at 40 (most-cited first); work 'lang' is null, record's $l code kept as raw_lang. 998 cluster links converted to same_as where URI pattern known ('(Spirit)' LC record excluded).
OpenGraph metadata only: name and URL of the Sceneweb artist page.
OpenGraph metadata of the Literary Encyclopedia person page; og:description is a truncated first sentence of the article; og:image is the site icon.

RDF/JS triple dump (schema.org) of the KB NTA authority p068242964 'Twain, Mark', plus labels of linked bibliographic records (author, contributor, about). The record states it is a pseudonym of Samuel Langhorne Clemens and links to the separate NTA record p068242956 for the real name.
OpenGraph tags of the Douban personage page (a long Chinese biography in og:description) and xhr_2.json, the personage's works API (first 10 of 196 book subjects, titles in Chinese translation).

embedded_opengraph.json is the biography page metadata (title, one-line description, portrait). browser_xhr_3.json is the config for Britannica's AI study-helper prompts; it only adds the short description 'American writer'.

Open Library author JSON (export_2.json) plus schema.org Person/Book microdata and OpenGraph from the author page; all about Mark Twain. alternate_names mixes genuine variants with junk co-author strings and other people (Sculley Bradley, Richmond Croom Beatty) - only clean variants kept; title field says '(pseud)'.

HTML partials for the Open Library subject page 'person:mark_twain_(1835-1910)': xhr_1 is a publishing-history chart (edition counts per year), xhr_2 the related-subjects facets, xhr_3 a carousel of books ABOUT the subject (biographies/criticism, not his works, so no work values taken). Little person data; co-occurring People facets recorded as related_agent.
Minimal OpenGraph block (title and URL only).

OpenGraph og:description is a generic site template. xhr_2.json is the SvelteKit __data.json for the Personality page (deduplicated array format): no biography (chapo/bodyJson empty), but it has the personality id, topic tags and a list of podcast episodes whose descriptions mention his works and dates. One episode text has typos ('1935-1910', '1835-910'), ignored.

xhr_8 is a name stub, xhr_9 the CoBiS agent record (IT_ICCU_CFIV_002662), browser_xhr_2 a SPARQL result the page pulls from Wikidata (Italian labels). Oddities: the SPARQL VIAF (53367783) differs from xhr_9's VIAF (50566653), and its LoC id no2003079632 is not Twain's usual n79021164; birth place 'Florida' means Florida, Missouri.
Disney Wiki (Fandom) article OpenGraph; og:description is the article lead (truncated) and lists Disney adaptations. browser_xhr_7/8 are ad-bidding responses (404 / no_bid), not about the entity.
schema.org BreadcrumbList + WebSite microdata only; the breadcrumb gives the author name 'Samuel Langhorne Clemens' and the author URL slug. No dates or bio in this file.

extraction_notes.site: Filmový přehled person or company ID
extraction_notes.notes: OpenGraph block from the person page; og:image is the site logo, not a portrait.
Library of America writer page: OpenGraph metadata and a WordPress oEmbed JSON (embed HTML + thumbnail). The oEmbed author_name (Ben Lasman) is the page's WordPress author, not related to Twain.
OpenGraph metadata for the Grove article: inverted heading and DOI-based URL. og:description is a boilerplate publisher line with a missing date; og:image is a default cover.
OpenGraph only from the Treccani encyclopedia entry; og:description is generic portal boilerplate, og:image is the site logo. Only the heading name is usable.

VIAF's MARC21 copy (as JSON) of the Library and Archives Canada authority record CAOONL|ncf10128469 (heading Twain, Mark, 1835-1910; 500 see-also to Clemens; 670 sources). 9xx fields are VIAF enrichments: 998 = VIAF cluster member records (listed in same_as as SOURCE|id, not URIs; excluded LC n 82045653 'Twain, Mark (Spirit)', and mis-clustered NKC jx20050822002 Olivia Langdon Clemens / PLWABN Karłowicz), 996 = records VIAF kept in other clusters (not used), 910/912 = title strings VIAF derived
OpenGraph metadata for the Quora topic page; only the topic title, thumbnail and URL. The '(author)' qualifier in the title is a disambiguator.

OpenGraph is page chrome (og:description is the generic site tagline). alternate_1.xml is the OPDS (Atom) feed for author 53, first page of 25 books, plus a 'See also' entry linking to English Wikipedia. One listed book ('The Best American Humorous Short Stories') is an anthology whose entry gives a download count instead of an author, so it is not attributed.
OpenGraph metadata containing only og:image (protocol-relative S3 thumbnail named Mark_Twain_686.jpg for authority 332). No title or description.
OpenGraph only from the La Pléiade author page: title and URL, no description or dates.

VIAF-style MARC21 authority record (JSON-ified MARCXML) for the Estonian ERRR/ELNET source record a11141529, with VIAF-added 9xx fields and 998 cluster links (SOURCE|id codes; only well-known patterns converted to URIs). One attributed title, 'Isamaa-kalender ...' (an Estonian almanac), is likely a contributor-level attribution. The 998 link LC|n 82045653 '(Spirit)' is a different entity and was excluded.
OpenGraph only from the Treccani Enciclopedia Italiana entry; description is generic boilerplate, image is the site logo. Only the heading name is usable.

OpenGraph metadata from FactGrid item Q273620; og:title combines real name and pseudonym, og:description is a compact '* birth place, + death place, description' string.

OpenGraph metadata for Open Plaques person 1709, which is 'James Wallace Richard Hall (1799-1860)', not Mark Twain; about_entity false, nothing extracted. The Wikidata P1430 value appears to point to the wrong person (or the id was reassigned).
Single schema.org Person stub with only a name.

museum-digital persinst JSON export (id 69516): name, life years, gender, authority references (BNE, BnF, GND, LoC, NDL, NPG, RKD, ULAN, VIAF, Wikidata) and per-language names/notes copied from Wikipedia (dated 11.08.2021). same_as capped at 40 (10 authority links + 30 of 35 Wikipedia links).

Dimensions.com element 'mark-twain' (height drawings): xhr_3/xhr_5/xhr_9 are the element's drawing/thumbnail/icon APIs; xhr_11 is the 'Authors & Writers' collection listing (33 people) from which only the mark-twain item was used. og:description misspells 'Clemen'. OpenGraph metadata of the Swedish History Museum (samlingar.shm.se) person page. The name is garbled in the source: first name 'Clemens Samuel', last name 'Langhorne, Mark Twain'; values kept as given.

OpenGraph metadata of the Geneastar (Geneanet) family-tree page; og:description is a truncated English family-background paragraph naming parents and siblings.
Birzeit Arabic Ontology concept API record imported from Princeton WordNet 3.1: English gloss and English synonyms; no Arabic gloss or Arabic words.
Global WordNet ILI instance metadata: a SKOS definition and a link to the source Princeton WordNet 3.0 synset. No lemma/name is given; life years come from the definition text.

VIAF-style MARC21 authority record (JSON-ified MARCXML) for the Bibliotheca Alexandrina (EGAXA) source record vtls000823270, with VIAF-added 9xx fields (works, co-authors, publishers, cluster links). 998 cluster links are given as SOURCE|id codes, not URIs; only those with a well-known URI pattern were converted to same_as. The 998 link LC|n 82045653 '(Spirit)' is a different entity and was excluded.
Lex.dk (Den Store Danske) article microdata: breadcrumb taxonomy, article authors (Jan Nordby Gretlund / Den Store Danske, not related agents) and an image object. No article text is included.

VIAF-style MARC21-in-JSON authority record (National Library of Ireland copy of LC n79021164 'Twain, Mark, 1835-1910') with VIAF cluster fields. 998 cluster links converted to same_as where a URI pattern is known ('(Spirit)' record and Alden/Conte pseudonym records excluded); 996 unmatched records skipped; 955/960 subject-ish names not used.

Portaro (Czech) authority API. xhr_3.json is the record for the pseudonym heading 'Conte, Louis de, 1835-1910' (NKC jn20000701083); xhr_4.json is a 'Found in these records' search returning the linked main authority 'Twain, Mark, 1835-1910' (jn19981002263, UUID a84f8e03-...); xhr_5.json is the see/see-also hierarchy tree; xhr_6.json is an empty file-directory listing. Field a998 labelled 'ID hesla v MeSH' (000073119) is a local id whose meaning is unclear.

xhr_7.json is the Primo (Ex Libris) authority PNX record from the Croatian BUKINET network (NSK), with heading, see-from tracings, notes, sources and biographical note in Croatian; embedded_opengraph.json only repeats the heading.
OpenGraph metadata from the Bedetheque author page 20036; title gives the inverted name, description is a generic site blurb. Only name, id and photo URL.

Only embedded_opengraph.json is about Twain (the entry page). xhr_18-25 are Next.js page props for other, prefetched entries (Cook, James; books and surfing; kook; London, Jack; Melville and Isabella Bird features; two History of Surfing sections). They only mention Twain in passing or link to /encyclopedia/twain-mark (id eos-1617), so about_entity is false for them and nothing was taken from them. The og:description is truncated at the source.

embedded_microdata.json is the schema.org WebPage/Person block from the Geni profile: names, death date, birthPlace, family links, and three long user-written 'About' texts (English with census transcriptions and a bibliography, Hebrew Wikipedia copy, Norwegian). Odd: birthDate is an empty string, birthPlace is only 'United States', and the name list includes 'Private User'. A census transcription gives a different spouse name ('Clieve Clemens'), which was ignored.

schema.org microdata (an Article 'Biografia' with the full Italian encyclopedia entry in description, plus a SiteNavigationElement of page chrome, ignored) and OpenGraph metadata from Sapere.it (De Agostini) page 'Mark Twain'.
schema.org Thing microdata for the Zhihu topic page '马克·吐温', with a Chinese biographical description (truncated with an ellipsis), image and Q&A counts.
